# Kartik Arora Codelabs

> Interactive technical tutorials, hands-on workshops, and step-by-step guides for mastering modern software engineering, Android development, and generative AI agents.

Welcome to the Codelabs portal by Kartik Arora ([codelabs.kartikarora.me](https://codelabs.kartikarora.me)). This site provides structured, step-by-step learning modules designed for developers, engineers, and AI practitioners.

## Author & Instructor
- **Author**: Kartik Arora
- **Website**: https://kartikarora.me
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/kartikarora

## Available Codelabs & Workshops

- [Compose Preview Screenshot Testing](https://codelabs.kartikarora.me/compose-preview-screenshot-testing/) ([Markdown](https://codelabs.kartikarora.me/compose-preview-screenshot-testing/index.md)): Learn how to set up Compose Preview Screenshot Testing, create and capture screenshots of composables, and incorporate screenshot tests into your CI workflow. (Duration: ~58 mins) | Tags: android, compose, testing
- [Hands-On Android App Building with Gemini in Android Studio](https://codelabs.kartikarora.me/gemini-in-android-studio/) ([Markdown](https://codelabs.kartikarora.me/gemini-in-android-studio/index.md)): Get hands-on experience with the latest Gemini powered coding features inside Android Studio. Working on a real-world multi-module project, you’ll scaffold new features with Agent Mode, convert wireframes into sleek Compose interfaces, run tests and use the Android CLI's powers. (Duration: ~131 mins) | Tags: ai, gemini, android-studio, agent-mode, compose, mcp, journeys, android-cli
- [Gemini SDK with Python (March 2025)](https://codelabs.kartikarora.me/gemini-sdk-python-march-2025/) ([Markdown](https://codelabs.kartikarora.me/gemini-sdk-python-march-2025/index.md)): A hands-on introduction to the Gemini SDK using Python, exploring text generation, multi-modal interactions, streaming, and function calling. (Duration: ~45 mins) | Tags: gemini, python, ai
- [I Build with AI and so can you! 🚀](https://codelabs.kartikarora.me/i-build-with-ai/) ([Markdown](https://codelabs.kartikarora.me/i-build-with-ai/index.md)): Learn to build better software by collaborating with AI. Discover how to use PRDs, ADRs, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to guide AI to build exactly what you need. (Duration: ~71 mins) | Tags: ai, gemini, agents
- [I Build with AI and so can you! (Android Edition) 🚀](https://codelabs.kartikarora.me/i-build-with-ai-android/) ([Markdown](https://codelabs.kartikarora.me/i-build-with-ai-android/index.md)): Learn to build better Android apps by collaborating with AI using the Antigravity CLI. Discover how to use PRDs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to guide AI to build exactly what you need. (Duration: ~63 mins) | Tags: ai, gemini, agents, android, kotlin, compose
